purpose: Synchronized synthetic operator diagnostics and exploratory normal-path rejection evidence; excluded from the final performance sample matrix.
notes: Production retains walk=0, the original two-dimensional grid; walk=1 is padded Morton and walk=2 groups eight row tiles in one dimension. Explicit K-block variants are not enabled.
GEMM/vector/chunk entries preserve three-sample means rounded to 0.001 ms; individual samples were not emitted. FFN tile entries preserve all three emitted timings after one excluded warmup.
Chunkwise checks use only synthetic inputs and are not full-model release qualification. The candidate is absent from serving binaries.

Exploratory candidate source was uncommitted; the exact measured executable/configuration hashes and all raw timings are retained. The immutable baseline executable corresponds to the recorded 190a459 source despite its runner metadata using the later documentation HEAD.
The final normal-path performance claims use the separate completed 100-sample-per-profile reports, not these diagnostic timings.

The rejected normal-path prototype changes grouped launch order and the initial FFN fusion together. Its A/B comparison does not isolate either change individually; the final implementation retains the qualified two-dimensional grid and the separately revised accumulator-reusing fusion.
